aims: This course introduces students to the rapidly evolving fields of Augmented Reality (AR), Virtual Reality (VR), and the emerging Metaverse. It covers fundamental concepts, hardware technologies, software frameworks, and design principles for immersive experiences.
objectives: 1. To provide strong foundation in AR, VR, MR, XR and Metaverse technologies|2. To explain evolution and working principles of immersive systems|3. To introduce AR/VR hardware including HMDs, sensors, controllers, eye tracking|4. To understand tracking systems including optical tracking and SLAM|5. To develop knowledge of real-time rendering and latency optimization|6. To teach 3D mathematics: vectors, matrices, quaternions|7. To provide practical exposure to Unity XR, Unreal Engine, ARKit, ARCore|8. To understand interaction paradigms: gestures, gaze, voice, locomotion|9. To introduce Metaverse: avatars, blockchain, NFTs, virtual economies|10. To prepare students for careers in immersive technology and spatial computing
outcomes: CO1: Recall concepts of AR, VR, XR and Metaverse|CO2: Explain technical components of immersive systems|CO3: Apply 3D mathematics in AR/VR systems|CO4: Analyze user interaction techniques|CO5: Evaluate different AR/VR development platforms|CO6: Design and develop AR/VR applications
unit1: UNIT I - FOUNDATIONS: Introduction to AR/VR/MR/XR, Reality-Virtuality Continuum, History (Sensorama to Apple Vision Pro), VR Systems (Immersive/Semi/Non-immersive), AR Systems (Marker/Markerless/Projection/SLAM), Metaverse Concepts (Digital Twins, Avatars), Applications (Gaming, Healthcare, Education, Retail)
unit2: UNIT II - HARDWARE & RENDERING: HMDs (Optical/Video See-Through), Tracking Systems (3-DOF/6-DOF, IMU, Optical Inside-Out/Outside-In), SLAM and Spatial Mapping, Input Devices (Controllers, Hand/Eye Tracking, Haptics), Rendering Pipeline (Real-time, Stereoscopic, Foveated, Latency Optimization)
unit3: UNIT III - 3D MATH & SPATIAL: Coordinate Systems (World/Object/Camera/Screen), 3D Transformations (Translation/Rotation/Scaling Matrices), Rotational Math (Euler Angles, Gimbal Lock, Quaternions, SLERP), Camera Models (Perspective/Orthographic, FOV, Frustum), Spatial Computing (Plane Detection, Mesh Reconstruction, Occlusion, Anchors)
unit4: UNIT IV - DEVELOPMENT & INTERACTION: Platforms (Unity XR, Unreal Engine, ARKit, ARCore, WebXR), Core VR Interactions (Teleportation, Locomotion, Grabbing, Laser Pointer), XR UI (World Space, Gaze/Gesture/Voice), Spatial Audio (3D Positioning, Ambisonics, Occlusion), UX Design (Reducing Motion Sickness, Accessibility, Feedback)
unit5: UNIT V - METAVERSE & FUTURE: Metaverse Architecture (Centralized/Decentralized), Digital Identity (Avatars, Facial Animation, Presence), Virtual Economies (Blockchain, Crypto, NFTs, Digital Ownership), Interoperability (OpenXR, WebXR, glTF), Ethics (Privacy, Biometrics, Addiction), Future (BCI, Volumetric Video, AI Avatars, Haptic Internet)
textbooks: Augmented Reality: Principles and Practice - Schmaltstieg & Hollerer|Virtual Reality - Steven M. LaValle|Learning Virtual Reality - Tony Parisi|Unity Virtual Reality Projects - Jonathan Linowes
